note: The decoded gate row this recipe reached when it shipped; tools/qa-cover-recipes.mjs renders it again and fails when median d or the moving share move more than 15 %, seamLocal leaves the cover TARGET, the file passes 2 MiB or the render exits non-zero. Measured 2026-10-20 on headless Chrome's software rung with CPU raster and libwebp 1.6.0.

treatment.request: Make a looping README cover for LitOpenCode out of its own name.
treatment.idea: A tide of weight rolls through drifting rows of the name while the bold name in the middle never thins.
treatment.recipeReason: The name is the only material, and a variable weight axis can move it without moving it.
treatment.hero: The brand word, set as rows of type.
treatment.beat: A swell of weight crosses the rows once per loop.

layers.slow: Rows drift one word length per loop, alternate rows opposite ways.
layers.mid: One weight swell rolls diagonally across every letter.
layers.beat: A cursor steps under each hero letter and carries back home.

system.rule: One weight field, gain of a swell.
system.copies: About eight hundred letters plus the hero word.
system.offset: Each letter's phase comes from its x and y on screen.

treatment.ambition: The wave reads by itself from one rule, and the drift keeps every letter moving through the encoder.
